raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 was re-delivered at 05:00 with the same 345 transactions. The fix parses both formats and deduplicates on txn_id, keeping the earliest-ingested copy; all business columns are identical between copies.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, ingest_ts, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT))) AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, ts) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
